instruction: Tidy up the desk: books go on the orange tray, mugs go on the cyan tray and the pen stands upright in the magenta pen holder.

attempts.code:
# Grasp green_pen and insert it upright into magenta_holder
obs = observe()
holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
cands = grasp_candidates("green_pen")

# Choose a candidate that grasps across the pen's short axis
cand = min(cands, key=lambda c: c["squeeze_width"])
grasp(cand)

# Move above the holder at a safe height above its rim
target_x, target_y = holder["center"][0], holder["center"][1]
carry_to(target_x, target_y, height=holder["rim_height"] + 0.15)

# Lower into the holder and release
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat(dz=0.15)
go_home()
check("green_pen", "magenta_holder")

# Grasp the pen lying on magenta_holder and insert it upright into the holder
obs = observe()
table_z = obs["table_z"]
holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
hx, hy = holder["center"][0], holder["center"][1]
rim_h = holder["rim_height"]

cands = grasp_candidates("green_pen")
cand = min(cands, key=lambda c: c["squeeze_width"])
grasp(cand)

# Lift well above holder
carry_to(hx, hy, height=rim_h + 0.18)

# Reorient gripper to tilt/align pen upright: approach along pen long axis
# The pen lies horizontally along side vector when grasped across short side.
# To make it stand upright, reorient gripper so approach is horizontal or pitch the gripper.
# With move_gripper, reorienting approach horizontally turns the held object vertically.
move_gripper(hx, hy, table_z + rim_h + 0.12, approach=[1, 0, 0], finger_axis=[0, 1, 0])

# Move directly over the holder opening
move_gripper(hx, hy, table_z + rim_h + 0.08, approach=[1, 0, 0], finger_axis=[0, 1, 0])
open_gripper()

retreat(dz=0.15)
go_home()
check("green_pen", "magenta_holder")

table_z = obs["table_z"]
pen_name = "green_pen" if "green_pen" in obs["objects"] else "green_mug"
holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
hx, hy = holder["center"][0], holder["center"][1]
rim_h = holder["rim_height"]

cands = grasp_candidates(pen_name)
cand = min(cands, key=lambda c: c["squeeze_width"])
grasp(cand)

# Move high above holder
carry_to(hx, hy, height=rim_h + 0.18)

# Pitch gripper horizontally so the pen (held along side axis) stands vertically
# Test approach=[1, 0, 0], finger_axis=[0, 0, 1] or [0, 1, 0]
# When approach points down [0, 0, -1] and finger_axis=[fx, fy, 0], side = approach x finger_axis is horizontal.
# To make side point vertically [0, 0, 1] or [0, 0, -1], approach must be horizontal and finger_axis horizontal:
# approach=[0, 1, 0], finger_axis=[1, 0, 0] -> side = [0, 1, 0] x [1, 0, 0] = [0, 0, -1] (vertical!)
move_gripper(hx, hy, table_z + rim_h + 0.14, approach=[0, 1, 0], finger_axis=[1, 0, 0], path="joint")

# Lower down towards holder opening
move_gripper(hx, hy, table_z + rim_h + 0.06, approach=[0, 1, 0], finger_axis=[1, 0, 0], path="line")
open_gripper()

retreat(dz=0.15)
go_home()
check("green_pen", "magenta_holder")
